ui_guide_text:
Main Mechanics
Food Rationing
Food must be rationed carefully to keep the crew alive.
If a crew member goes 3 days without food, they die.
If any crew member dies from natural causes, the game ends.
You are the captain — it is your responsibility to keep your crew alive.

Health System
Mouthwash is the main medical resource used to treat sickness and injuries.
Injury Stages
Healthy → Injured → Critical → Death
Injuries can worsen over time if they are not treated.
Mouthwash can stabilize a Critical crew member back to Injured.
Regular crew members cannot be fully healed with mouthwash alone.

Eviction — Airlock Day
Every 7 days, an Airlock Day occurs.
On Airlock Day, you may choose to evict one crew member.
The chosen crew member must have been sedated beforehand.
Sedatives must be secretly added to that crew member's food on a previous day.
If they are not sedated, they cannot be safely evicted.

Crew Members
Criminal
Loyalty
The Criminal has a Loyalty Value.
Loyalty can increase or decrease depending on your decisions.
Arguments may occur between the Criminal and other crew members.
Taking the Criminal's side can increase loyalty.
Going against the Criminal can decrease loyalty.
Reaching maximum loyalty unlocks the Criminal's special ability.
Special Ability — Intimidate
Intimidate allows the Criminal to force other crew members to complete tasks.
Forced tasks do not require their normal resource cost.
This can make difficult or expensive tasks easier to complete.

Engineer
The Engineer specializes in repairs, technical problems.
Provides better results during events involving ship repairs or machinery.
Negotiation
The Engineer can provide stronger rewards or better outcomes when assigned to certain tasks.
However:
The Engineer may request specific items or resources before agreeing to complete the task.
You must decide whether the potential reward is worth the cost.

Doctor
The Doctor specializes in treating injured crew members.
Medical Treatment
The Doctor can fully heal an Injured crew member for 2 Mouthwash.
The healed crew member returns to Healthy.
Their previous injury will no longer worsen.
They can still become injured again from future events.

Chef
The Chef specializes in managing the crew's food supply.
Passive Ability — Food Efficiency
Reduces the ship's overall food consumption.
Makes food supplies last longer throughout the journey.
Airlock Ability — Sedated Meal
Before an Airlock Day, the Chef can add sedatives to a crew member's food.
The sedated crew member becomes eligible for eviction on the next Airlock Day.
This allows the captain to remove dangerous or unwanted crew members.
journal_exiled_tied: {name} is tied up in the storage bay. The ship is finally quiet. So quiet it takes some getting used to.
